versions.note: A figure drawing with photos or screenshots inside it shows in the paper instead of a note that the PDF has it.
Symbols in titles and headings read as characters (VLA-Δ) instead of TeX commands; an affiliation keeps its web address in brackets, with no empty brackets left.
List items show one marker, the paper's own, without a blank line under each; diagram labels of several lines are drawn line by line inside their boxes.
Plot and diagram labels read upright instead of mirrored; affiliations and contact lines after the abstract read in the header.
Image-heavy papers reduce oversized figure bitmaps to fit the device bundle limit while keeping every figure.
Affiliation lines keep their math marks and contact details; all indexed equations remain readable.
Affiliations beneath the abstract read on separate lines.
Font setup text no longer appears on custom title pages, including FDE-Gym.
Text badges inside equations keep their labels, including DocPilot’s four agent actions.
Contents › Tables lists the paper's tables; an image arXiv doesn't serve leaves a note in its figure instead of stopping the paper.
A figure the device can't prepare says so in place instead of stopping the paper; very large drawings are drawn smaller.
Figures missing from arXiv's page say so; placeholder author lists give way to the paper's real authors.
Unusual math styling is left out rather than stopping the paper.
Panels under one caption read as one figure.
The converter reorganised; the papers read the same.
Shared checks with the on-device PDF reader.
Title pages and author tables; very large images left out.
Fewer papers refused on first open.
Citations that can't be resolved and leftover macros are removed; the reader sets math colours.
Author names and affiliations laid out more cleanly.
